method: Verified prior exact bytes in Git, read diffs with enclosing fixture/assertion/consumer context. Whole-file review only where stated; prior snapshots are not relabeled. Native CI rerun remains necessary.

entries.review: Read CF.11 and enclosing real-repository setup, trap, run_guard and expect_case. Two distinct newly committed tasks blobs are removed only beneath the mktemp repository after verifying loose objects exist; commit/tree metadata remains available. Both public dispatchers must return independent tool-error status 2 and a failed diagnostic. Earlier success/specs-only/criterion-change controls remain. This replaces a POSIX shim that Windows children bypassed; it does not reinterpret an infrastructure error as a criterion change.

Read added precheck helper and all four new tests with Fixture lifecycle and public precheck contracts. Argument vectors remain separate; calls have 30-second deadlines and fixture cleanup. Literal malformed hashes/verdicts require rejection plus no next round/attempt side effect. Integer spelling/range checks require a diagnostic; quoted/newline filename fingerprint checks independently hash fixture bytes. Permission-denial control restores permissions in finally and requires non-root POSIX. Native Windows follows the existing PowerShell suite matrix; Bash twin cases execute on POSIX, avoiding accidental WSL bash.exe selection. This is no claim of Windows Bash coverage.

Read changed fixture/serialization/process-launch hunks with Expect-Diagnostic, Write-Manifest, barrier lifecycle and validator/snapshot consumers. Shared native argument serializer preserves path atoms in a deliberately spaced temporary root. Singleton arrays are serialized as JSON arrays, preserving malformed shape. Handoff hashes are recalculated so rejection tests shape rather than stale digest; original evidence is restored. Root-array envelopes invoke both validator and snapshot and require TASK_INPUT_JSON. Existing typed diagnostic and positive controls remain; publication-boundary child lifetime remains owned by enclosing CI suite, while copy-mode control has explicit deadline and finally disposal.

Read entire helper and both collection-layer callsites and detector process contracts. Checkout-controlled script/host argv select actual public detector; private PATH supplies one disposable provider command. Python worker records its own PID, returns a literal success/fail status or ignores TERM and hangs. Assertions independently require exact provider stdout, exit status, elapsed deadline and exited worker; POSIX zombie tolerance requires /proc state Z, Windows checks a process handle with finally close. Temporary root is scoped and version fixture text is explicit UTF-8. This exercises actual subprocess behavior on success; outer subprocess timeout is 12 seconds. Failure-path descendant cleanup remains detector/CI-owned, not a guarantee of arbitrary-tree cleanup by this test helper.

Non-string check IDs now assert public typed validation failure (exit1, exact stdout diagnostic, empty stderr), while only exact source-evidence string delegates. Case-mismatched string still passes legacy route. This follows the guarded production contract rather than preserving its former ContainsKey exception or coercion.

Only explicit native-arguments.ps1 additive protection is admitted. Compared canonical invariants against b3b997ed: this is the sole membership addition. Existing baseline digest is unchanged; omission/duplication and unrelated membership mutations remain detected.
